author: Y Combinator
description:
Ramp (S15) runs the financial operations of tens of thousands of businesses and increasingly does that work with agents. The median company using Ramp saves 7.5% a year on expenses, and Ramp now does over $2 billion in annual revenue, growing 25% faster than it was a year ago. In this episode of How to Build the Future, co-founder and CEO Eric Glyman sat down with YC’s Garry Tan to talk about the business model insight that let Ramp out-invest every competitor in software, how they’re developing their own company AI brain, and what he thinks the real cause of death for large companies.
